environment.description: Service deployed on a bare EC2 instance (m5.large) in a public subnet with a public IP. Security group allows inbound TCP 8443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No load balancer, no WAF, no network ACL restrictions beyond default. The Go binary is compiled with CGO_ENABLED=1 and -gcflags='-N -l' (optimizations disabled). Instance runs Amazon Linux 2 with ASLR partially effective but no stack canaries enforced at the Go runtime level for this array-based overflow.
